title: HL CCTP Bridge
tagline: A USDC bridge into Hyperliquid L1 built using Circle's CCTP to remove fees apart from gas.
description:
A USDC bridge into Hyperliquid L1 built using Circle's CCTP to remove fees apart from gas..

Frontend is a basic vanilla HTML page. Web3 uses ethers.js.

Bridging is a 2-step process.
Circle CCTP is used to bridge to Arbitrum.
Hyperliquid's Arbitrum bridge smart contract is used to bridge into Hyperliquid L1.

There is no backend.
